name: One stay entered as two trips (an internal border crossing) matches one EES record

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-06-30&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-06-30 and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) to open the trip sheet
Enter entry date 2026-06-01 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit date 2026-06-10 (data-testid=trip-exit)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) to open the trip sheet
Enter entry date 2026-06-11 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit date 2026-06-20 (data-testid=trip-exit)
Enter 20 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used) and type exactly '2026-06-01 2026-06-20' in the EES records box (data-testid=ees-records)
The result codes (data-testid=ees-code) are exactly one code, 'match' (its data-code attribute is match); no code 'exit-dates-disagree' is shown
